PONDICHERRY UNIVERSITY
B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering - Semester V
CS T53 DATABASE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

Course Objectives: To understand database design, query languages and storage.

UNIT I  INTRODUCTION 9 Hours
Purpose of Database Systems, Views of Data, Data Models, Database Architecture, Database Users and Administrators

UNIT II
RELATIONAL MODEL AND SQL
Relational Model, Keys, Relational Algebra, SQL Queries, Nested Subqueries

UNIT III DATABASE DESIGN
Functional Dependency, Data Anomalies, Normalization, 1NF 2NF and 3NF, BCNF

UNIT IV - STORAGE AND INDEXING
File Organization, Indexing, B+ Tree Index, Hashing

UNIT V TRANSACTIONS
Transaction Concepts, Concurrency Control, Recovery System

Text Books: Silberschatz, Korth and Sudarshan, Database System Concepts.
